items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 8 June 2026 5:35am
items.description:
##Yesterday##

Mainly dry and bright with sunny spells, then a few scattered showers developing late afternoon and this evening, possibly becoming more widespread for a while tonight.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 9°C and max. air temperature 15°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

1-4


##Wind Speed##

15


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

W 10-15, backing SW this afternoon, increasing 15-20 by the evening, then 20-25 tonight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers later. Occasional hill fog, especially later.


##Comments##

Strong wind in places tonight.


##Today##
